evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap).
